name: RC-B10-0102/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of violence in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and asking others to act. It asks Rwanda to pull its troops out of eastern Congo and stop helping the M23 rebels. It wants the fighting to stop, the airport in Goma reopened so aid can get in, and humanitarian corridors opened. It also asks the European Union to suspend its raw materials deal with Rwanda and to consider freezing budget support and military aid until Rwanda changes course.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only asks the EU and others to act.
- **Who it affects:** Rwanda, the M23 rebels, Congo's people, and EU aid and minerals deals.
- **What happens next:** The EU Council and Commission decide whether to act on these requests.
